Meta’s operating margin is calculated as income from operations divided by revenue.

From the FY2024 10-K excerpts:
- Fiscal year 2024 Revenue: $164,501 million [DOC-1]  
- Fiscal year 2024 Income from operations: $69,380 million [DOC-1]

Operating margin 2024 = 69,380 / 164,501 ≈ 42.2%  

ANSWER: Approximately 42.2%
